text:
jess: FYI we started seeing duplicate callbacks from the webhook-sample after the runtime retry tweak. Small % (0.6%) but reproducible in staging.
ci-bot: deploy: java-sdk@3.4.1 rolled to prod (2026-03-24T11:12:03Z) :rocket:
nate: Do we have a repro log? key question: are we ignoring Retry-After when it's an HTTP-date?
sophia: Pasted sanitized trace: 
```
POST /callbacks -> 429
Headers: Retry-After: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:15:00 GMT
client retry immediately -> 200 (duplicate)
```
liam: Looks like Java SDK change last night used Integer.parseInt(retryAfter) directly and thrown NumberFormatException -> fallback to immediate retry. Oops.
jess: Also noticed sample app doesn't attach any idempotency token on outgoing callbacks. Relying on receivers to dedupe is risky.
nate: Proposal: 1) SDKs must parse Retry-After as either seconds or HTTP-date (RFC7231). 2) SDKs should support a default X-Redwood-Idempotency header generator for outgoing webhooks. 3) Add duplicate_callback metric and a lightweight server-side dedupe sample in sample-apps.
sophia: Quick PoC for Java parse: 
```java
String ra = resp.getHeader("Retry-After");
long waitSecs = 0;
try {
  waitSecs = Long.parseLong(ra);
} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
  Instant t = DateTimeFormatter.RFC_1123_DATE_TIME.parse(ra, Instant::from);
  waitSecs = Duration.between(Instant.now(), t).getSeconds();
}
waitSecs = Math.max(0, waitSecs);
Thread.sleep((waitSecs*1000) + jitterMs());
```
liam: Python helper for reference: 
```py
ra = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
wait = 0
if ra.isdigit():
    wait = int(ra)
else:
    wait = max(0, (parsedate_to_datetime(ra) - datetime.utcnow()).total_seconds())
await asyncio.sleep(wait + jitter())
```
nate: CI side: add a sample-app lint that fails if outgoing webhook endpoints are sent without X-Redwood-Idempotency (or explicit opt-out). Also add an e2e test in samples that simulates 429 with both numeric and HTTP-date values.
jess: Telemetry: server should emit duplicate_callback_detected with sample_id and webhook_id when we replay and receiver acked twice. We can use that to alert and rollback quickly.
liam: I'll open SDK PRs (java + go + python) with parsing fixes and unit tests for both formats. I'll add a feature flag "honor_retry_after" default true so we can toggle if weird regressions occur.
sophia: I'll add the linting rule and a short doc in devex onboarding about webhook idempotency best practices.
nate: Acceptance criteria: unit tests for Retry-After parsing (int and RFC-date), integration e2e that asserts client waits for date-based RA, sample-apps add idempotency header by default, CI lint, and telemetry metric with dashboard.
jess: Great. Assigning: liam -> SDK PRs, sophia -> CI lint + docs, nate -> telemetry + staging smoke test. ETA Blitz: EOD today for PRs, staging validation tomorrow.
liam: Opening PRs and tagging reviewers. Will include changelog blurb for release notes.
sophia: Adding lint rule to samples CI now. Will reference policy: samples must opt-out explicitly to avoid silent dedupe problems.
jess: Thanks team :thumbsup: Keep thread updated if you find anything surprising.
